_meta.arm_membership: in_enforced_arm is the pair closure of rail_reachable: a reachable trap brings its lookalike, so enforcement's harm reduction is always read next to what the same rail does to safe purchases.
_meta.description: Per-scenario record of where the tool_constraints arm can fire, and which scenarios it therefore runs. Derived from the sandbox by app.phase2.sandbox.reachable_rail_findings; regenerate with scripts/generate_phase2_enforcement_scope.py.
_meta.reason_completeness: reasons and offers cover the checkout states actually swept; a world past the sweep budget can refuse for reasons not listed here. rail_reachable and in_enforced_arm are unaffected.

surfaces.checkout_control: a checkout control has to be moved off its opening value first
surfaces.offer_as_listed: the offer is refused exactly as the merchant presents it
surfaces.optional_disclosure: an optional checkout field has to be disclosed first
surfaces.payment_rail: a rail other than the offer's default has to be chosen first
surfaces.unswept: the checkout state space exceeded the sweep budget without deciding
